title: hook.request@3
description: deep-hook's request line: the agent's hook JSON, stamped with seq and id; a spooled call let through because the hub was late is marked late, a SessionStart says which billing keys are set, and a matched guard entry can carry a note on what this call does.

seq.description: Wall-clock ns since the Unix epoch when the hook started, as a canonical decimal string.

id.description: The event's ULID, minted with its seq.

matched.description: The guard entries in rules.json the call matched, by name.

notes.description: For a matched entry, by name, what deep-hook read of this call that a person needs to act on it, such as the other checkout a git command is aimed at or the dispatch it would run; the hub shows it with that entry's denial.

stage.description: For a matched entry whose match is effect:unknown-reach-delete, by name, the absolute folders the delete names, for the hub to stage as a copy-on-write copy before it runs. An entry with no list here names a value the line can't know: nothing can be staged for it.

payload.x-opaque: the agent's hook JSON, unchanged; its adapter reads it

late.description: Set on a spooled call deep-hook let through because the hub did not acknowledge it in time or did not reply by its hold.

billing.description: Whether each billing key is set in the environment the agent gave deep-hook, by name: true or false, never a value.
